name: com.berkterek.framework
description: Engine-agnostic infrastructure for Unity projects built from the unity-claude-ai-template-repo template: IEventBus, DLog, the ISaveLoadService/ISaveLoadDal chain, the SerializedOps Editor applier that lets an agent assign inspector references without writing a throwaway Editor script, and a dev-only debug command registry an agent can list and run from the Editor (optionally mirrored into SRDebugger).
